Nature Desk – C Eco-Friendly Gift Set | ND52

The Nature Desk – C Eco-Friendly Gift Set | ND52 is a thoughtfully curated sustainable gifting solution designed for companies, offices, and organisations looking to promote eco-conscious values. Each item in this premium set reflects responsibility, craftsmanship, and environmental awareness. Featuring essentials like the Forest Tile (6″x6″), Plantable Calendar (3.5″x5″), Jute Sling Bag (15″x11″x2″), Cork Diary A5 (Pro), and Bamboo Stylus Pen with Flap, this eco-friendly gift set makes a meaningful impression while supporting a greener lifestyle.

Perfect for employee welcome kits, festive corporate gifting, client appreciation gifts, and sustainable brand promotions, the Nature Desk – C Eco-Friendly Gift Set combines visual appeal with practical daily-use products. The addition of items like the Cork Sticky Note, Forest Keychain, and Large Wooden Desk Organizer with Drawer enhances productivity while promoting sustainability at work. Crafted with natural, biodegradable, and reusable materials, this set stands out as a top choice among eco-friendly corporate gifts in India.

Key Features of Nature Desk – C Eco-Friendly Gift Set | ND52

  • Forest Tile (6″x6″) – Beautiful nature-themed tile for home or office desk décor.
  • Plantable Calendar (3.5″x5″) – Eco-friendly seed-based calendar that grows into plants after use.
  • Jute Sling Bag (15″x11″x2″) – Spacious, reusable, and durable bag made from natural jute fibre.
  • Cork Diary A5 (Pro) – Premium cork-cover diary with eco-conscious craftsmanship.
  • Bamboo Stylus Pen with Flap – Sustainable writing tool with a sleek bamboo finish.
  • Cork Sticky Note – Reusable sticky note pad made from natural cork.
  • Forest Keychain – Nature-inspired wooden keychain for a minimalist eco look.
  • Large Wooden Desk Organizer with Drawer – Spacious organizer with compartments for stationery, cards, and essentials.

Why Choose This Eco-Friendly Gift Set?

The Nature Desk – C Eco-Friendly Gift Set ND52 is designed for businesses that want to create a positive environmental impact. With rising demand for eco-friendly corporate gifts and sustainable office gifting, this set helps brands strengthen their identity while embracing responsible choices. All products are crafted from materials like bamboo, cork, jute, and wood—making them renewable and biodegradable.

This set also serves as a premium welcome kit for new employees, offering a blend of utility and sustainability. Items like the Cork Diary A5 Pro and Wooden Desk Organizer elevate workspace aesthetics, while the Bamboo Stylus Pen and Plantable Calendar encourage eco-friendly habits. The Jute Sling Bag adds everyday functionality, making it a complete and practical gift package.

Ideal For

  • Corporate gifting and festive gifting
  • Employee welcome and joining kits
  • Client appreciation and promotional events
  • Eco-conscious branding and sustainability campaigns

Choose the Nature Desk – C Eco-Friendly Gift Set | ND52 to promote sustainability effortlessly while offering high-quality, useful, and stylish products. Build your brand’s reputation with meaningful gifts that help create a greener tomorrow.
